rules.title: Cartwright Act Amendments on Algorithmic Pricing
rules.requirement: The Cartwright Act prohibits using or distributing common pricing algorithms to collude on pricing or terms, and prohibits coercing users to adopt algorithmic pricing recommendations.

coverage.summary: Applies to businesses using or distributing common pricing algorithms, including apartment rental companies.

rules.exemptions: Single-firm algorithms using only a business's own data are not covered by the law.
rules.quoted_span: The Cartwright Act now expressly prohibits (1) using or distributing common algorithms to collude on pricing, and (2) coercing users to adopt algorithmic recommendations.
